brief: make a website for my aunt's flower shop called Petal & Stem in Jaipur. people should see the bouquets with prices, order one for delivery, and know the shop timings and where it is
outcome: Done: the site is workable. Every done-when item passes with Audit's evidence and the render check is clean.

asked: Please send the list of bouquets with the name and price (in rupees) of each. Do you also have photos of them?
What are the shop's opening days and hours, the full address, and the phone number? A Google Maps link is a bonus if you have one.
How should a customer place an order on the site?

Besides bouquets with prices, ordering, timings and location, I think visitors will also want to know which parts of Jaipur you deliver to, the delivery charge, and whether same-day delivery is possible. Should I include these? Please give me the details or tell me to leave any out.
questions_to_user.answer:
Address: 12 MI Road, near Panch Batti, Jaipur 302001. Phone: +91 141 400 5566.
Timings: 9am to 8pm, Monday to Saturday. Closed on Sunday.
Bouquets: Red rose dozen ₹899, Sunflower bunch ₹699, Mixed seasonal ₹999, White lilies ₹1,199, Orchid box ₹1,499.
Delivery: same day inside Jaipur if ordered before 4pm, ₹99 delivery charge. Orders go to WhatsApp +91 98290 11223, pay on delivery.
Photos: not yet, leave empty spots for now.

used.changes: Dropped Animations, Stories and the separate Viewport fix (the viewport tag is built into the scaffold), and split Core sections into bouquets, order form and info.

done_when.criterion: The page shows the shop name Petal & Stem and mentions Jaipur.
The page lists exactly these bouquets with prices: Red rose dozen ₹899, Sunflower bunch ₹699, Mixed seasonal ₹999, White lilies ₹1,199, Orchid box ₹1,499.
Each bouquet has an empty image placeholder spot.
An order form lets a visitor pick a bouquet and enter name, phone and delivery address, and its submit action opens a WhatsApp message to +91 98290 11223 with those details filled in.
The page states same day delivery inside Jaipur for orders before 4pm, a ₹99 delivery charge, and pay on delivery.
The page shows shop timings of 9am to 8pm Monday to Saturday and closed on Sunday.
The page shows the address 12 MI Road, near Panch Batti, Jaipur 302001, the phone +91 141 400 5566 as a tap-to-call link, and a map link or embed for the address.
The file has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and no broken in-page links.
